1.w: The one separating himself seeks his own desire, against all sound wisdom he breaks out.

2.w: A fool does not delight in understanding, but rather in uncovering his heart.

3.w: With the coming of the wicked also comes contempt, and with shame, reproach.

4.w: The words of the mouth of a man [are] deep waters; the fountain of wisdom [is] a flowing brook.

5.w: To lift up the face to a wicked one [is] not good—to overthrow a righteous one in the judgment.

6.w: The lips of a fool enter into strife, and his mouth calls for blows.

7.w: The mouth of a fool [is] ruin to him, and his lips [are] a snare to his soul.

8.w: The words of a whisperer [are] like things to be gulped, and they go down into the chambers of the belly.

9.w: The one being slack in his work, he [is] also a brother to a lord of destruction.

10.w: A tower of strength [is] the name of YHWH—to it a righteous one runs and is set on high.

11.w: The wealth of the rich one [is] the city of his strength, and like a wall set high in his imagination.

12.w: Before the face of destruction, the heart of a man is exalted, and before honor [is] humility.

13.w: The one returning a word before he hears, it [is] folly to him and disgrace.

14.w: The spirit of a man will sustain him in his sickness, and a stricken spirit—who can bear it?

15.w: The heart of an understanding one acquires knowledge, and the ear of the wise ones seeks knowledge.

16.w: The gift of a man makes room for him, and it leads him before the face of great ones.

17.w: The first in his dispute [seems] right, until his neighbor comes and examines him.

18.w: The lot makes quarrels cease, and it separates between mighty ones.

19.w: A brother transgressed [is] as a city of strength, and quarrels [are] like the gate bar of a citadel.

20.w: From the fruit of the mouth of a man, his belly is satisfied; with the produce of his lips he is satisfied.

21.w: Death and life [are] in the hand of the tongue, and those loving it will eat its fruit.

22.w: He who has found a wife has found good, and he obtains favor from YHWH.

23.w: [With] supplications the poor one speaks, and a rich one answers fiercely.

24.w: A man of companions may come to ruin, and there is a lover adhering more than a brother.
